testcase.name: theItemTableNamesTheSessionModel

failure.message: the model the item worker ran in named on its row, so two items of one run are compared by cost alone and a role that crossed models reads as one budget (issue #972)

testcase.failure: RED 972.1 report#theItemTableNamesTheSessionModel: with the `model` cell taken back out of state.sh's row, the two-model item's row had no cell for the pair. The case log line 1 is "the row names the worker's model with the most tokens and how many further models it used: expected 'deepseek-v4.1-flash +1', got ''" (exit 1).

testcase.name: aStateWithNoModelPrintsADash

failure.message: the dash a state with no recorded model prints, so a state written before the field existed carries an empty cell where the report spells a figure it did not measure (issue #972)

testcase.failure: RED 972.2 report#aStateWithNoModelPrintsADash: with the `model` cell taken back out of state.sh's row, the older state's row printed nothing where `-` is asserted. The case log line 2 is "a state that predates the field prints - in the model column, not a guess: expected '-', got ''" (exit 1).
